label: AFFECTION

cover.headline: 5 small touches *that rebuild closeness*
cover.sub: Affection that asks for nothing back.

points.heading: Hold hands on walks
points.body: Simple, familiar, and easy to start.
points.panel: Reach for his hand on your next walk.

points.heading: A hand on the shoulder
points.body: A quick, warm touch while passing by.
points.panel: Touch his shoulder as you walk past today.

points.heading: Sit close on the couch
points.body: Closer than usual, without needing a reason.
points.panel: “Come sit with me for a bit.”

points.heading: A longer goodbye hug
points.panel: Hold the hug a few seconds longer tomorrow.

points.heading: Ask what he likes
points.body: Touch means different things to different people.
points.panel: “What kind of affection makes you feel close to me?”

caption:
When couples drift, everyday touch is often one of the first things to fade. Bringing it back doesn’t have to start with anything big.

Small, warm touches that ask for nothing in return can make a home feel close again. Here are five to try this week.

Save this for this week, and follow @spotseason for more small steps.
